articles.title: Twins aim for prospect Kaelen Culpepper to return this season despite going on IL
articles.description: MINNEAPOLIS — Kaelen Culpepper is headed to the injured list with only 11 games remaining, but the Minnesota Twins’ goal is for him to return before the season ends.

articles.title: Emmanuel Rodriguez emotional after Twins call-up: ‘Full disclosure: I cried’
articles.description: Rodriguez missed nearly three months of minor-league action after suffering a torn ulnar collateral ligament in his left thumb on May 1.
